svg.title: Public vs. private report
svg.desc: Public vs. private report. Public mode: File counts by type; Likely technologies, such as ASP.NET Web Forms, C# or Python; How many sensitive files were skipped; No project, folder or file names. Private mode, internal use only: Everything in the public report; Project name and the full file tree (arvore.txt); Master Page usage and references by status; Static links between pages, code-behind files and controls.
